name: Summer Night Miracle Mission
original_name: サマーナイトミラクルミッション
source:
The protagonist, a plain, gloomy, otaku-type second-year middle school girl,
ends up paired with the class favorite, Suou Natsuki, in a lottery for the summer-end forest school’s test-of-courage event.
Seizing this unparalleled opportunity, she lets her curiosity and playful fantasies run wild,
and prepares a mission to experience a romance that won’t end with just one summer…
translation:
主角，一个朴素、阴沉、宅男型的国中二年级女生，
最终与全班最受欢迎的须王夏希搭档参加森林学校暑期勇气测试活动的抽签活动。
抓住这个无与伦比的机会，她尽情发挥自己的好奇心和俏皮的幻想，
并准备了一项任务，去体验一场不会仅仅在一个夏天就结束的浪漫……
